mapper.select: select from ai_skill_component order by component_key
select from ai_skill_component where id = #{id} for update
mapper.insert: insert into ai_skill_component ( id, component_key, display_name, description, draft_revision, enabled, revision, created_by) values (#{id}, #{key}, #{displayName}, #{description}, 0, true, 0, #{actor})
mapper.update: update ai_skill_component set display_name = #{displayName}, description = #{description}, enabled = #{enabled}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and revision = #{expectedRevision}
mapper.select: select count(*) from ai_agent_skill_binding b join ai_skill_release r on r.id = b.skill_release_id where r.skill_id = #{skillId}
select id, skill_id, relative_path, content, content_digest, updated_at from ai_skill_draft_file where skill_id = #{skillId} order by relative_path
mapper.insert: insert into ai_skill_draft_file (id, skill_id, relative_path, content, content_digest) values (#{id}, #{skillId}, #{path}, #{content}, #{digest}) on conflict (skill_id, relative_path) do update set content = excluded.content, content_digest = excluded.content_digest, updated_at = now()
mapper.delete: delete from ai_skill_draft_file where skill_id = #{skillId} and relative_path = #{path}
mapper.insert: insert into ai_skill_release ( id, skill_id, version, generation, name, description, bundle_json, bundle_digest, state, created_by) values ( #{id}, #{skillId}, #{version}, #{generation}, #{name}, #{description}, cast(#{bundleJson} as jsonb), #{digest}, 'STAGED', #{actor})
mapper.select: select from ai_skill_release r join ai_skill_component c on c.id = r.skill_id where r.skill_id = #{skillId} order by r.created_at desc
